scope: Bounded macOS document-format wording and local authored-note exact-citation regression
fresh_process_scope: Three native app launches, each recreating its in-process hosted Knot endpoint worker; store inspectors run separately. No independent holder/recipient acceptance is claimed.
limits: Named-recipient publication, individually chosen source attachment transfer, recipient withdrawal and sharing cold reopen remain open at the source-owner handoff.
Headed format choice covered Djot; no additional authoring formats were introduced.
Ordinary application fullscreen behavior is unqualified; the interrupted acceptance run is preserved.
Other operating systems, physical keyboard/IME, OS assistive activation, power loss and personal resident/custody installation remain separate.
